questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. We met a lot of people _______ our stay in Ahmedabad.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We met a lot of people _______ our stay in Ahmedabad.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 1.
 
Key Points
  • The primary issue in the sentence is the selection of the correct preposition.
  • "During" is used to indicate a period of time in which something happens.
  • In this context, "during our stay in Ahmedabad" correctly conveys that the meeting of people happened within the period of their stay.
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.
 
Correct Sentence: "We met a lot of people during our stay in Ahmedabad."
 
Additional Information
  • Option 2: "while" – Incorrect because "while" is used to indicate two simultaneous actions. It would be more appropriate for a clause, e.g., "We met a lot of people while we were staying in Ahmedabad."
  • Option 3: "on" – Incorrect because "on" is typically used with specific days or dates, e.g., "on Monday."
  • Option 4: "in" – Incorrect because "in" is used for longer periods of time such as months, years, or specific locations, but does not convey the duration as effectively as "during."

questions.question: Directions: Each of the following sentences in this section has a blank space and is followed by four choices. Select the most appropriate choice to fill in the blank and mark your response accordingly. A major advertising ______ was planned to launch the new brand of garments.
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Each of the following sentences in this section has a blank space and is followed by four choices. Select the most appropriate choice to fill in the blank and mark your response accordingly.

A major advertising ______ was planned to launch the new brand of garments.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'campaign.'

Key Points

  • The given sentence is saying something about a major advertisement of the new brand of garments. (दिया गया वाक्य कपड़ों के नए ब्रांड के एक प्रमुख विज्ञापन के बारे में कुछ कह रहा है)
  • Campaign means an organized course of action to achieve a goal. (किसी लक्ष्‍य को पाने के लिए योजना-निर्माण)
    • Example: Trump's presidential campaign won endorsement from several celebrities.
       

Conclusion: To achieve the goal of new brand launching, a major advertising course of action was planned. (नए ब्रांड लॉन्चिंग के लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए, एक प्रमुख विज्ञापन की योजना बनाई गई थी)

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Complete Sentence: A major advertising campaign was planned to launch the new brand of garments.

Additional Information

  • Let us explore the other options:
    • Ambush means a surprise attack from a hidden position. (घात लगाकर किया गया हमला)
    • Pension means money that is paid regularly by a government or company to somebody who has stopped working (retired) because of old age. (सेवानिवृत्त या पदनिवृत्त व्‍यक्ति को सरकार या कंपनी द्वारा नियमित रूप से मिलने वाली धनराशि; पेंशन)
    • Election means the time of choosing a Member of Parliament, President, etc. by voting. (मतदान द्वारा संसद सदस्‍य, राष्‍ट्रपति आदि का निर्वाचन)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. They are going to give me a lovely present, but I cannot _______ what it will be.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

They are going to give me a lovely present, but I cannot _______ what it will be.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: guess.

Key Points

  • The word "guess" means to form an opinion or give an answer about something when you do not know much or anything about it. (अनुमान लगाना)
    • Example: She tried to guess the answer to the difficult question.
  • The context tells us that the person has no idea what kind of nice present they will be giving him.
  • Hence, we can infer that the correct word for the blank is 'guess'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Give (देना): To provide someone with something.
    • Example: They give gifts to each other every year.
  • Gist (सारांश): The main or general meaning of a piece of writing, a speech, or a conversation.
    • Example: He didn't understand every detail, but he got the gist of the story.
  • Guest (मेहमान): A person who is invited to visit or stay in someone's home.
    • Example: We are expecting a guest for dinner tonight.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. Can you please ______ me in sorting out these files on my computer?
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Can you please ______ me in sorting out these files on my computer?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'assist'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word to fill in the given blank is 'assist'.
  • The word 'assist' means 'to help सहायता करना'.
  • If we 'assist' someone, we give them information, advice, or money. 
    • Example: The public is urgently requested to assist police in tracing this man.
  • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.
    ​

Correct Sentence: Can you please assist me in sorting out these files on my computer?

Hinglish

  • दिए गए रिक्त स्थान को भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'सहायता' है।
  • 'assist' शब्द का अर्थ है 'मदद करना'
  • अगर हम किसी की 'सहायता' करते हैं, तो हम उन्हें जानकारी, सलाह या पैसा देते हैं।
    • उदाहरण: The public is urgently requested to assist police in tracing this man.
  • इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
Words Meaning
Abet encourage or assist (someone) to do something wrong, in particular, to commit a crime कुछ गलत करने के लिए (किसी को) प्रोत्साहित करना या सहायता करना, विशेष रूप से अपराध करने के लिए।
Hinder to make it more difficult for somebody/something to do something
व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के लिए कठिनाई पैदा करना, किसी के काम में बाधा डालना
 Connive  to work secretly with somebody to do something that is wrong; to do nothing to stop somebody doing something wrong
गुप्‍त रीति से कोई ग़लत काम करना; किसी को ग़लत काम करने से न रोकना; ग़लत काम की अनदेखी करना

questions.question: Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Though technology has advanced, environmental problems still have a drastic ______ on mankind.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The success and achievements of a school mostly ________ on its experience and resourcefulness.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The success and achievements of a school mostly ________ on its experience and resourcefulness.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'depend'.
 
Key Points
  • The word "depend" means to be contingent on or determined by. (निर्भर होना)
  • The success and achievements of a school are generally contingent on its experience and resourcefulness.
  • The other options: "credit," "achieve," and "begin" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4'.

Additional Information

  • Achieve (प्राप्त करना): means to successfully reach a desired objective.

questions.question: Directions: In this section each of the following sentences has a blank space and each sentence is followed by four options. Select the most appropriate option to fill the blank space. The management is going to change the ______ criteria for undergraduate courses.
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: In this section each of the following sentences has a blank space and each sentence is followed by four options. Select the most appropriate option to fill the blank space.

The management is going to change the ______ criteria for undergraduate courses.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'eligibility'

Key Points

  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • available- able to be bought or used खरीदा या इस्तेमाल किया जा सकता है 
    • curricular- relating to the subjects studied in a school, college, etc. and what each subject includes एक स्कूल, कॉलेज, आदि में अध्ययन किए गए विषयों से संबंधित और प्रत्येक विषय में क्या शामिल है

So the correct sentence is- The management is going to change the eligibility criteria for undergraduate courses.

questions.question: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. Blood transfusion is a procedure that starts with the doctor (1) ________ the patients' blood type. In case of a wrong transfusion in the immune (2) ________ of an individual, it leads to an infection.
questions.questionHtml:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Blood transfusion is a procedure that starts with the doctor (1) ________ the patients' blood type. In case of a wrong transfusion in the immune (2) ________ of an individual, it leads to an infection.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: determining; system

Key Points

  • Determining refers to a method or process of finding out or establishing something. (निर्धारण)
  • In the context of blood transfusion, it is crucial to identify and establish the patient's blood type before proceeding with the transfusion.
  • The word "determining" fits well to convey the idea of finding out the patient's blood type.
  • System refers to the ways or methods by which a system operates or functions. (व्यवस्था)
  • The phrase "immune system" refers to the complex network of cells and proteins that defend the body against infections.
  • A wrong blood transfusion can trigger an immune response and result in an infection, making "system" the suitable word to complete the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete Passage: Blood transfusion is a procedure that starts with the doctor (1) determining the patients' blood type. In case of a wrong transfusion in the immune (2) system of an individual, it leads to an infection.

Additional Information

  • Diagnosing: Identifying or determining the nature or cause of a problem or condition. (निदान करना)
  • Structure: The arrangement or organization of parts that make up a whole. (संरचना)
  • Treating: Providing medical care, therapy, or taking actions to alleviate or cure a disease, condition, or problem. (इलाज)
  • Process: A series of actions, steps, or operations conducted to achieve a particular result or outcome. (प्रक्रिया)
  • Settling: Resolving or reaching a conclusion in a dispute, argument, or uncertainty. (तलछट)
  • Order: Arrangement or organization, often based on a specific system or set of rules. (आदेश)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Sita was ______ to find out what had happened at the neighbour’s place that morning.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Sita was ______ to find out what had happened at the neighbour’s place that morning.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'curious'.
 
Key Points
  • The word "curious" means eager to know or learn something. (उत्सुक)
  • Sita was eager or curious to find out what had happened at the neighbor’s place.
  • The other options: "eccentric," "odd," and "peculiar" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 2'.

Complete Sentence: Sita was curious to find out what had happened at the neighbour’s place that morning.

Additional Information
  • Eccentric (सनकी): means unconventional and slightly strange.
  • Odd (अजीब): means different from what is usual or expected; strange.
  • Peculiar (अजीब): means strange or odd; unusual.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. These days you get very good_______ if you buy consumer goods online.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

These days you get very good_______ if you buy consumer goods online.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "deals"

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
  • objects: a material thing that can be seen and touched.
  • deals: take part in commercial trading of a particular commodity.
  • spaces: position (two or more items) at a distance from one another.
  • covers: put something on top of or in front of (something), especially in order to protect or conceal it.
  • We use the word 'deals' when referring to transactions between people or online.
  • The word deals is appropriate in the given sentence.

The correct sentence is: These days you get very good_deals_ if you buy consumer goods online.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2

Hinglish

  • आइए दिए गए विकल्पों के अर्थ को देखें।
  • वस्तुएं(objects): एक भौतिक वस्तु जिसे देखा और छुआ जा सकता है।
  • सौदे(deals): किसी विशेष वस्तु के वाणिज्यिक व्यापार में भाग लेना।
  • रिक्त स्थान(spaces): एक दूसरे से दूरी पर स्थिति (दो या अधिक आइटम)।
  • ढकना (cover): किसी चीज़ को (किसी चीज़) के ऊपर या सामने रखना, विशेष रूप से उसे बचाने या छिपाने के लिए।
  • लोगों के बीच या ऑनलाइन लेन-देन का जिक्र करते समय हम 'डील्स' शब्द का इस्तेमाल करते हैं।
  • डील(सौदे ) शब्द दिए गए वाक्य में उपयुक्त है।
  • सही वाक्य है: इन दिनों अगर आप उपभोक्ता सामान ऑनलाइन खरीदते हैं तो आपको बहुत अच्छे सौदे मिलते हैं।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word. It is the duty of every Indian to ______ communal harmony.
questions.questionHtml:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word.

It is the duty of every Indian to ______ communal harmony.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'maintain'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word for the given blank is 'maintain'.
  • It means 'to make something continue at the same level, standard, etc.' (किसी वस्‍तु को उसी स्‍तर, मानक आदि पर बनाए रखना, जारी रखना)
    • Example: We need to maintain the quality of our goods but not increase the price.
  • If we maintain something, we continue to have it and do not let it stop or grow weaker.
  • The given sentence is trying to express the fact that it is the duty of every Indian to preserve communal harmony. (दिया गया वाक्य इस तथ्य को व्यक्त करने का प्रयास कर रहा है कि सांप्रदायिक सौहार्द बनाए रखना प्रत्येक भारतीय का कर्तव्य है)
  • Hence, 'maintain' is correct in the given context.
     

Correct Sentence: It is the duty of every Indian to maintain communal harmony.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Present: existing or happening now. (वर्तमान, मौजूदा, इस समय का)
    • Repair: to put something old or damaged back into good condition. (किसी पुरानी या क्षतिग्रस्‍त वस्‍तु की मरम्‍मत करना)
    • Release: to allow somebody/something to be free. [व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को (किसी से या कहीं से) मुक्त करना, जाने देना]

questions.question: Select the most appropriate words to fill in the blanks. Teaching is so much more than ____ in front of a whiteboard as one of the most important elements of teaching is ______ a relationship with students.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate words to fill in the blanks.

Teaching is so much more than ____ in front of a whiteboard as one of the most important elements of teaching is ______ a relationship with students.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1.
As the sentence suggests, while Teaching, one 'stands' in front of a whiteboard and not 'wait'. Thus, options 2 and 3 are incorrect.
building: make or become stronger or more intense vs enabling: give (someone) the authority or means to do something.
Thus, ' the most important element of teaching is building (not enabling) relationships with students. (building- making relationships with students more stronger and more intense). Thus, option 4 is incorrect.
Correct sentence: Teaching is so much more than standing in front of a whiteboard as one of the most important elements of teaching is building a relationship with students.

questions.question: Direction: Select the correct word for the blanks in the given sentence. Health is a state of ______ being, and a ______ is used to draw water from the ground.
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: Select the correct word for the blanks in the given sentence.

Health is a state of ______ being, and a ______ is used to draw water from the ground.
questions.solution: "Well being" means a state of being healthy and happy. Example: Seeing her grandchildren gave her a sense of well-being. questions.question: Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank. He comes here _________ .
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank.

He comes here _________ .
questions.solution: The correct answer is: daily. It means occurring every day. Contextually, "daily" is an adverb of frequency that fits the simple present tense "comes," correctly describing a regular habit or routine that happens on a daily basis.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. He ______ a heinous crime.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
He ______ a heinous crime.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. committed

The sentence refers to a crime, and crime doesn't just 'happen', it is not something that can be 'made' and it is not something that 'occurs' on its own. A crime is 'committed' by a person.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Fear evolved over millions of years to protect us from ______.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Fear evolved over millions of years to protect us from ______.
questions.solution: The only option that fits this requirement is danger. Danger refers to the condition or state of being at risk or exposed to harm, injury, or threat. The sentence implies that fear is an evolutionary adaptation that helps us avoid dangerous situations.

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the most suitable word. At first the water ______ blue, then grey.
questions.questionHtml:
Fill in the blank with the most suitable word.

At first the water ______ blue, then grey.
questions.solution: "Seemed" is used here to describe the appearance or perceived color of the water at different times or under different conditions. The verb "seem" is often used when something appears a certain way to the senses but may not actually be that way. Therefore, the correct sentence is: 'At first the water seemed blue, then grey.'

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. The team leader asked for a ______ report to be given, in not more than one page.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

The team leader asked for a ______ report to be given, in not more than one page.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Option 4".
Key Points
  • In the given sentence, a kind of report that was asked by the team leader should be no more than one page.
  • So all in all, the report has to be brief but comprehensive.
  • If we look at the given options
    • Complex (adjective) means "difficult to understand because of having many different parts".
    • For example, The news article was so complex that I could not understand it.
    • Compound (noun) means "Combination" or "Something consisting of two or more different parts".
    • For example, Salt is a compound of sodium and chlorine.
    • Curt (adjective) means "rudely blunt and brief".
    • For example, She gave me an extremely curt answer.
    • Concise (adjective) means "Short and clear with necessary words".
    • He wrote a concise summary of the editorial.
Hence, the correct answer that makes the given sentence meaningful is "Concise".

questions.question: Direction: Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank. The children enjoyed the ______ very much.
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Siva is a hard worker. He works __________.

questions.question: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. Mosquito means small fly. It has a transmitter segmented body and a _______________ of wings. Male mosquitoes mainly feed on plant _______________.
questions.questionHtml:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.
Mosquito means small fly. It has a transmitter segmented body and a _______________ of wings. Male mosquitoes mainly feed on plant _______________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 3.

Key Points

  • The word "pair" means two corresponding or similar items that are used together. (जोड़ा)
    • Example: She bought a new pair of shoes for the party.
  • "Nectar" refers to a sweet liquid secreted by flowers to attract pollinating insects and birds. (मधु)
    • Example: Bees collect nectar from flowers to make honey.
  • The context tells us that a mosquito is a little fly. It has two wings and a transmitter-segmented body. The primary food source for male mosquitoes is plant juice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: pair; nectar.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Kind (प्रकार): A group of people or things having similar characteristics.
    • Example: She is the kind of person who helps everyone.
  • Drink (पेय ): A liquid that can be swallowed as refreshment or nourishment.
    • Example: Water is the healthiest drink.
  • Set (समूह): A collection of objects considered as a unit.
    • Example: She has a set of fine china.
  • Beverage (पेय पदार्थ): Any type of drink except water.
    • Example: Coffee is a popular morning beverage.
  • Couple (जोड़ा): Two people or things of the same sort considered together.
    • Example: The couple went on a vacation together.
  • Liquor (शराब): Alcoholic drink, especially distilled spirits.
    • Example: He prefers liquor over beer.

questions.question: Directions: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Credit card _______ has increased in recent years.

Additional Information

  • Let us explore  the other options:
    • 'Flake' means a small thin piece of something. (किसी वस्‍तु का छोटा पतला टुकड़ा, पपड़ी, कण)
    • 'Freed' means to let somebody or something leave or escape from a place where he/she/it is held. (बंदीगृह से छोड़ना; क़ैद से आज़ाद करना; बंधनमुक्त करना)
    • 'Fluke' means a surprising and lucky result that happens by accident, not because you have been clever or skillful. (आश्‍चर्यजनक और सुखद संयोग से प्राप्‍त परिणाम)
       

Hinglish

  • दिया गया वाक्य क्रेडिट कार्ड धोखाधड़ी के कृत्य में वृद्धि के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
  • इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'fraud' है।
  • 'Fraud' शब्द का अर्थ है ग़ैर-क़ानूनी ढंग से धन आदि ठगने की क्रिया; धोखाधड़ी।
    • उदाहरण: Tax fraud costs the country millions in lost revenue.


अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: Credit card fraud has increased in recent years.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Can you ______ between these two shades of green?

  • The given blank needs a word that would describe being able to differentiate between two shades of the same colour.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. William ______ his friends not to intrude into his family’s affairs.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The smoke coming out of the factory chimneys was polluting the air, which was becoming a major _______ for the local residents.

Complete Sentence: Do not accuse him; he has done no harm to you.

Additional Information

  • Let us explore  the other options:
    • 'Admire' means to respect or like somebody/something very much. (किसी के प्रति आदर व प्रशंसा का भाव रखना)
    • 'Assure' means to make something sure or certain. (निश्‍चित करना, सुनिश्‍चित करना)
    • 'Admit' means to agree that something unpleasant is true or that you have done something wrong. (किसी अप्रिय बात की सत्‍यता स्‍वीकारना या अपनी ग़लती मान लेना)
       

Hinglish

  • दिया गया वाक्य किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के बारे में बात कर रहा है जिसने कुछ भी गलत नहीं किया है।
  • इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'accuse' है।
  • 'Accuse' शब्द का अर्थ है किसी व्‍यक्ति पर कुछ गलत करने का आरोप लगाना; क़ानून तोड़ने का दोषी ठहराना।
    • उदाहरण: Politicians accuse the media of talking up the possibility of a riot.


अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: Do not accuse him; he has done no harm to you.
